body:
## Updates
* CPython 3.16.0a1
* LLVM 22.1.3 -> 23.1.3 

## Distribution changes
* Python 3.10 has reach end-of-life and is no longer included in this release or future releases. 
* Python 3.16 is included in the release, with 3.16.0a1.
* On Windows, all DLLs with a signed certificate are retrained. Previously some signatures were removed when the DLL was stripped.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/compare/20261009...20261013
